purpose: Adjudicate the coherent Gaussian N=64 sextic shift seen in P1c using an exactly unbiased cross-configuration U-statistic estimator.

estimators.legacy_global_plugin: mu6_bar - 15 mu4_bar mu2_bar + 30 mu2_bar^3, where each moment is pooled over configurations and sites
estimators.sitewise_plugin: site average of [mu6hat_x - 15 mu4hat_x mu2hat_x + 30 mu2hat_x^3]

primary_analysis.conservative_se: max(between-seed SE, quadrature mean of within-seed jackknife SEs)

interpretation.pass: The original P1c Gaussian sextic miss is attributable to finite-sample plug-in estimation rather than a physical Gaussian sextic interaction.
interpretation.fail: A statistically significant nonzero unbiased U-statistic requires auditing the analytic zero-target or generator implementation.
